# agent-ops-stack

> Machine-readable project context. Checked against the repository sources on 2026-10-12.

## Project type

A Git repository containing a JSON manifest, Bash installer, tests, CI, and documentation. The installer fetches seven public Git repositories listed in `agent-ops.manifest.json` and prints their declared `provides` and `consumes` labels. It does not install or run those modules.

## Canonical links

- Repository: https://github.com/ellmos-ai/agent-ops-stack
- Manifest: https://github.com/ellmos-ai/agent-ops-stack/blob/main/agent-ops.manifest.json
- Installer: https://github.com/ellmos-ai/agent-ops-stack/blob/main/install.sh
- Security policy: https://github.com/ellmos-ai/agent-ops-stack/blob/main/SECURITY.md
- License inventory: https://github.com/ellmos-ai/agent-ops-stack/blob/main/THIRD_PARTY_LICENSES.md
- Own license: https://github.com/ellmos-ai/agent-ops-stack/blob/main/LICENSE

## Interfaces and requirements

- `install.sh`: requires Bash, Git, and either `jq` or Python 3. It runs `git clone` for each listed source. Default target is `modules` beneath the current working directory; the first argument can select another target.
- `agent-ops.manifest.json`: lists seven repositories, selected refs, and descriptive boundary/wiring fields.
- Python project metadata currently records version `1.3.4`; its wheel contains metadata and license files rather than an agent-operations runtime. Use the Git checkout and installer for the project workflow.

## Manifest repositories

- `ticket-master`: https://github.com/dev-bricks/ticket-master
- `lock-master`: https://github.com/dev-bricks/lock-master

## Related projects

- COMA is an optional sibling for local agent process lifecycle and job-file status. It is not a module in this manifest: https://github.com/ellmos-ai/coma
- CareCenter for Codex contains unofficial Windows Codex maintenance instructions and is independently maintained: https://github.com/dev-bricks/CareCenter-for-Codex
- ellmos-ai/stacks provides a catalog and composition overview: https://github.com/ellmos-ai/stacks
- open-bricks is the umbrella organization: https://github.com/open-bricks

## Security and license boundaries

The installer uses Git network access and runs with the caller's environment and permissions. Manifest `boundaries` values are descriptive; this repository does not enforce them or sandbox the installer. Fetched modules have separate code, setup, security, and license scopes. The dated license inventory records direct LICENSE-file checks at the listed source commits; it is not a complete SBOM or a transitive-license certification.

## Checks

```sh
python -m pytest -o addopts='' -ra
python -m ruff check .
python -m compileall -q tests
bash -n install.sh
python -m json.tool agent-ops.manifest.json
```

Ubuntu CI also builds a PEP 517 wheel and source archive, checks the metadata-only wheel and source contents, then installs the test extra from the extracted source archive and runs checks.

The maintainer response policy is to acknowledge vulnerability reports within 48 hours and provide initial triage within five business days. This is a response policy, not a remediation deadline.
